title: Electrospray Ionization Mass Spectrometry Insights into the Assembly of Lanthanide-Containing Clusters
claim: Fragile lanthanide-containing clusters require gentle ESI-MS settings to reduce measurement-induced fragmentation.
explanation: The authors describe lowering capillary, cone, and fragmentation voltages, keeping the source relatively cool, and extracting ions rapidly to preserve detectable cluster ions.
scope: ESI-TOF-MS analysis of weakly bound or otherwise fragile lanthanide-containing clusters.
conditions: The authors report typically keeping the source below 200 °C and using an appropriate sample concentration.
caveats: ESI remains capable of fragmenting weakly coordinated clusters; concentration choices and source cleanliness also matter.
